result.reason: The operative language adopts New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County, satisfying the preferred position. The edit is limited to replacing the inconsistent Singapore law and forum language in Section 28.1, while preserving the existing submission, waiver, and temporary-injunctive-relief provisions in Section 28.2. Drafting is professional, though the exclusive-jurisdiction language is unnecessarily duplicated across Sections 28.1 and 28.2.
